Hot water denatures and coagulates hemoglobin and serum proteins, permanently setting them as insoluble bonds within the silk fibers.

Detailed Analysis:
Heat coagulates proteinaceous stains (such as blood, egg, and milk), binding them permanently into insoluble protein-fiber matrix networks. Hence, hot water must be strictly avoided during blood stain removal.

topic: Commercial Hospital Laundry Operational Workflow Sequence
questionText:
Arrange the sequential operational workflow stages through which soiled hospital linen passes in a commercial laundry:
(A) Collection of soiled/infected linen from hospital wards in designated color-coded bags
(B) Sorting, weighing, and classifying linen into soiled, infected, and specialty categories
(C) Washing, thermal/chemical disinfection, bleaching, souring, and high-speed hydro-extraction
(D) Drying, flatwork ironing/calendering, quality inspection, folding, and packaging for redistribution

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Commercial Hospital Laundry Operational Workflow Sequence.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Fabric and Apparel (Commercial Hospital Laundry Operational Workflow Sequence):
A, B, C, D

Detailed Analysis:
Hospital laundry workflow follows: collection & bagging (A) -> sorting & classification (B) -> washing & disinfection (C) -> ironing, inspection & dispatch (D).
Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText: What visual shape characterizes an 'A-Line' garment silhouette?

options.text: A perfect round circle like a sphere
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A straight cylindrical tube from shoulder to hem
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Fitted at the shoulders or waist and gradually widening smoothly towards the bottom hem, resembling the letter 'A'
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Silhouette Classification: A-Line.

options.text: Fitted tightly around the ankles and wide at the chest
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Fabric and Apparel (Silhouette Classification: A-Line):
Fitted at the shoulders or waist and gradually widening smoothly towards the bottom hem, resembling the letter 'A'

Detailed Analysis:
The A-line silhouette flares gently from a fitted bodice or waist outward to the hemline, universally flattering many body types.
Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
